name: gossamer_dawn
theme: a dawn hedgerow hung with dew-beaded orb webs — down one silk radial to the web's coiled center, into a water bead on the cable, and the bent light inside the bead opens back out onto the meadow the hedge stands in

registers.name: hedgerow
registers.palette: pale pink-orange light and cool grey-green
registers.scene: a tall hedgerow at first light seen from the meadow at standing height, dozens of round silk orb webs strung between the branches and the grass stems, every thread beaded with water, low pink-orange light through drifting mist, pale green leaves and seed heads scattered across the whole hedge
registers.target: a round silk orb web beaded with water
registers.loop_target: a tall hedgerow at first light seen from the meadow at standing height, dozens of dew-beaded orb webs strung between the branches, low pink-orange mist

registers.name: orb_web
registers.palette: silver and pale violet on soft grey
registers.scene: an orb web spun across a gap in the hedge, straight silk spokes running out from a pale center to the anchor lines, a spiral of silk wound between the spokes with its turns spaced wider toward the rim, water beads strung in even rows along every thread, soft grey-green twigs and pale dawn sky beyond the web's frame
registers.target: a dense pale knot of silk

registers.name: silk_hub
registers.scene: a knot of thick ropy silk cables at the middle of the web, cables running out from it in every direction, the innermost coils of the spiral looped tight across them, clear round water beads strung along each cable in ranks, warm pink-orange light along the silk and cool shadow between the strands

registers.name: bead_lens
registers.palette: cool pale green and pale blue
registers.scene: inside a clear water bead, a curved wall of water bending the dawn light into broad pale bands, fine motes suspended through the water, a bright band of light drawn along the curve, cool green and blue depth away from it

registers.name: meadow
registers.scene: a wide dawn meadow seen from above the grass, long lines of hedgerow running across it between pale gold fields, mist lying low in the hollows, first pink-orange light spread across the whole valley, small stands of trees scattered along the hedge lines

music_theme: a hedgerow at first light, hushed and gentle, soft plucked strings over a low pad, a bright airy swell where the water bead opens onto the meadow
